title: IKEv2: Update parameters from IANA assignments
description:
Update various value strings and range strings from recent RFCs and
IANA assignments.

Some of these are #if 0 out by the preprocessor because dissection
isn't implemented yet.

https://www.iana.org/assignments/ikev2-parameters/ikev2-parameters.xhtml

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

It was actually removed in RFC 5996 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5996#section-3.15.1), but as it was in RFC 4306 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4306#section-3.15.1), the first IKEv2 RFC, I suppose we could keep it.
